leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a state variable to manage an array of image objects
Implement a component that renders a list of images using the map method
Configure an event handler to update the current image index on click
Apply conditional rendering to display a selected image in a larger view
Construct a gallery layout with thumbnails and a main image display
Integrate image sources and alt text from the state data into the UI
Manipulate the state to cycle through images using previous and next buttons
